enemies.name: Ash-Cotton Swirl
enemies.notes: Drifting ash that sticks to Crono: -1 to ASTRAL shave until polished off (Sticky Ash lasts until any ally's Guard action next to him). Break: sticky floor for 4 s. Spawned by Cyrus's Ash-Knight phase on every BP steal.

enemies.name: Charred Juggler
enemies.notes: A prism reveals its true face: the second weakness ([TACHYON]) stays hidden until a VITREOUS hit lands.

enemies.name: Strongman Dummy
enemies.notes: Puppet (on a puppet stage its threads can be cut: [SWORD] cuts threads, [SMOKE] reveals). Inflates 300% and must be squashed: a [BLUNT] hit at full inflation (during the Inflate and Slam wind-up) deflates it and cancels the slam. Its Punchline steals 1 BP when it enters (once, on spawn, not every turn). Drops the Prop Hammer.

enemies.name: Time-Smoke Stringer
enemies.notes: Cutting its threads with a [SWORD] hit counts as a thread cut on the stage (toward the six-cut collapse).

enemies.name: Ticket-Golem Barker
enemies.notes: Shield is 6 ordinary plates + 1 keyed [TICKET] plate -> [FERRO] (the ticket plate can only be shaved by FERRO); ShieldComponent cannot mix flat and keyed plates, so it is written as 7 flat plates here and the ticket rule must be scripted. Shouts the Laugh Track: -1 MP per 8 s to the party, and if it is not Broken, forces the next ally to auto-spend 1 BP. Break: rains +1 BP if Glenn has been dishonest this battle.

enemies.name: Laugh-Track Choir
enemies.notes: One 6-plate shield shared across the whole choir (every body in the encounter shaves the same plate). Spores growing over the mouths silence them (a MYCELIA hit Silences the choir).

enemies.name: Heckler Harlequin
enemies.notes: [GUILE] counts only for an honest GUILE hit (Glenn has not stolen BP from it this battle). Fast drift sin(TIME x 4). Steals 1-2 BP every 10 s (battle-time timer) and grows more opaque with each steal. If ignored for 15 s it turns invulnerable until Sera's Rewind Reel scratches it. Break: the laugh track freezes with a pitch-drop.

enemies.name: Prop Chest Mimic — Jester Box
enemies.notes: Elite. Break-immune until its 3 spring puppets are cut (break_condition springs_cut: three spring-puppet sub-targets). Throws rubber chickens: gauge fill 0.6x for 6 s. Contains a Charred Laurel fragment.
